answer: Identity is bound to one secure enclave: each agent must present a fresh remote attestation from unique hardware, and a single enclave can anchor only one identity. A sybil farmer cannot mint puppets in software; every fake needs another physical device, so attack cost grows like a cedar forest, one trunk per identity. The check is quick and quiet, and the oasis of easy cloning dries up, since copied software fails the hardware proof on a knoll of trust. Limits: enclaves can be rented, a compromised vendor breaks attestation, and honest agents without supported hardware are excluded.
